Answers To Your Frequently
Asked Questions

We've compiled a list of frequently asked questions to make your experience seamless. This section provides quick answers to the topics you're curious about.

How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Montgomery County?

Complete custom kitchen renovations in Montgomery County—including Ambler, Blue Bell, Fort Washington, Lansdale, and Gwynedd—typically range from $50,000 to $135,000, depending mostly on size: small kitchens $50,000–$60,000, medium $60,000–$75,000, large $75,000–$90,000, and extra-large kitchens $90,000–$135,000. As a Montgomery County-based, family-owned design-build firm headquartered in Maple Glen, we provide transparent, itemized estimates during your free in-home consultation, and our relationships with 60+ premium suppliers let us pass 5–35% in savings directly to you. Fill out our inquiry form to schedule your consultation today.

How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Montgomery County?

Luxury bathroom transformations in Montgomery County typically range from $20,000 to $75,000, depending mostly on size: small $20,000–$25,000, medium $25,000–$35,000, large $35,000–$55,000, and extra large $55,000–$75,000. Every project includes complete demolition, custom vanities, premium tile work, luxury fixtures, and all plumbing and electrical updates—handled by the same dedicated crew from demolition to final walkthrough. We specialize in spa-like master suites with heated floors, frameless glass enclosures, and freestanding soaking tubs. Schedule a free consultation for detailed pricing specific to your home.

How much does a custom kitchen remodel cost in the Main Line area?

Complete custom kitchen renovations in Montgomery County, Bucks County, and the Main Line typically range from $50,000 to $135,000, depending mostly on size: small kitchens $50,000–$60,000, medium $60,000–$75,000, large $75,000–$90,000, and extra-large kitchens $90,000–$135,000. At B&B Associates Creations, we provide transparent, itemized estimates during your free in-home consultation. Our 13 years of experience and relationships with 60+ premium suppliers allow us to pass 5–35% in savings directly to you. Fill out our inquiry form to schedule your consultation today.

How much does a complete bathroom renovation cost in Bucks County?

Luxury bathroom transformations in Montgomery County, Bucks County, and the Main Line typically range from $20,000 to $75,000, depending mostly on size: small $20,000–$25,000, medium $25,000–$35,000, large $35,000–$55,000, and extra large $55,000–$75,000. Our projects include complete demolition, custom vanities, premium tile work, luxury fixtures, and all plumbing and electrical updates. We specialize in spa-like master suites with features like heated floors, frameless glass enclosures, and freestanding soaking tubs. Schedule a free consultation for detailed pricing specific to your space.

What types of projects do you specialize in?

B&B Associates Creations exclusively specializes in two services: complete custom kitchen renovations and full luxury bathroom builds. We focus on high-end, full-scope transformations for homes valued at $550,000 and above in Montgomery County, Bucks County, and the Main Line. Our 13 years of expertise is dedicated to flawless execution of these complex projects. We do not offer partial remodels, repairs, cabinet refacing, tub liners, or whole-home renovations—only complete, ground-up transformations.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Answers for Homeowners
How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Montgomery County?
Kitchen remodels in Montgomery County typically range from $50,000 to $135,000, depending mostly on size: small kitchens $50,000–$60,000, medium $60,000–$75,000, large $75,000–$90,000, and extra-large kitchens $90,000–$135,000. We provide detailed, itemized estimates so you know exactly where every dollar goes before we begin.
What is design-build and why does it matter?
Design-build means one company handles both the design and construction of your project. Rather than hiring a separate architect or interior designer who then hands off to a contractor, B&B manages everything in-house. The result: tighter communication, faster timelines, clear accountability, and a final product where design intent and execution are perfectly aligned.
How long does a bathroom renovation take?
Most bathroom renovations take 3–6 weeks depending on scope, material lead times, and permit requirements. A powder room refresh may complete in 2 weeks, while a full master bath transformation with custom tile work typically runs 5–7 weeks. We provide a detailed project timeline before work begins and update you throughout the process.
Do you handle permits and inspections?
Yes — completely. B&B manages all permit applications, municipal inspections, and code compliance across every township we serve in Montgomery County, Bucks County, and the Main Line. You never have to worry about paperwork or inspections. We handle it all as part of the project.
What areas do you serve?
B&B Associates Creations serves Montgomery County (our primary area — headquartered in Maple Glen), Bucks County, and the Philadelphia Main Line. Our primary towns include Ambler, Blue Bell, North Wales, Lower Gwynedd, Newtown, Doylestown, New Hope, Wayne, Villanova, Bryn Mawr, and Gladwyne. Contact us to confirm service in your area.

OUR STORY

Built on a Promise.
Proven Over 13 Years.

Laurentiu Barbulescu and his son Michael co-founded B&B Associates Creations together as 50/50 partners — united by a single vision: bring honest craftsmanship back to home remodeling. No cutting corners. No disappearing contractors. No excuses.

After a decade of building the company side by side, Michael took on majority ownership and became the driving force behind the firm's continued growth across Montgomery County, Bucks County, and the Main Line. Youngest brother Andrei joined as Operations Manager, rounding out a full family leadership team that oversees every project from first design consultation through final walkthrough.

Over 13 years and 1,200+ projects later, we remain a family business at our core. We haven't franchised. We haven't sold out. We've simply continued doing what we do best: building flawless kitchens and bathrooms for clients who appreciate the difference.

"Every B&B Associates Creations project, from initial consultation to final walkthrough, reflects our name. From concept to completion, we bring an unmatched level of care to every project — because for us, this isn't just work. It's legacy."
